School Committee of the Whole.check: review: "Committee of the Whole" is a specific body made up of all members of the school committee meeting together. "Comité Escolar Completo" ("Complete School Committee") does not convey this meaning and could mislead readers. A faithful rendering would be something like "Comité Escolar en Pleno" or "Comité de la Totalidad del Comité Escolar".
